game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the arrows value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the rune gate using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The rune gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the rune gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 3 (intro tier): Index Archery
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Collapsed Dome'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how arrows changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Collapsed Dome.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The rune gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
